description: A request to add a tag to, or remove a tag from from, objects within a set

op.description: Operation to perform: add or remove

jsonCond.description: The selection of records included in the operation, expressed as a structure rather than in CCMS's command language. The service validates it and generates the condition itself, so values are never interpreted as syntax.

filter.description: The name of a filter to be applied to selection of records included in the operation
